text:
Both summaries are accurate on the numbers, the free-month confound, the cost, the sales claim, and the 21 October meeting and November start. Neither misstates who decided what.

The difference is the word limit. Response A comes to about 112 words, under the 120 cap. Response B comes to about 124 by my count, which breaks the explicit constraint. A also puts the conclusion up front ("inconclusive") and frames the last bullet as a decision needed, which suits a busy manager. B is slightly less direct and omits the "inconclusive" framing.

A is better because it keeps the same content within the limit.

Verdict: A
